Name: Forward Email
Author: admin
Description: Use the Forward Email action to forward emails that include previous threads. With the appropriate permissions, this action can send emails from a mailbox different than the one specified in the integration configuration. This action doesn't run on Google SecOps entities.

Parameters.Description: A location where the attachments are stored. By default, the action attempts to upload attachments from the Cloud Storage bucket. The possible values are GCP Bucket or Local File System. The default value is GCP Bucket.
An optional email address from which to send an email if permissions allow it. By default, the email is sent from the default mailbox that is specified in the integration configuration.
The email ID or the internetMessageId value of the email to forward.
A mailbox folder in which to search for an email. To specify a subfolder, use the “/” forward slash, such as {Inbox/Subfolder}.
A comma-separated list of email addresses for the email recipients, such as user1@example.com, user2@example.com.
A comma-separated list of email addresses for the email CC field, such as user1@example.com, user2@example.com.
A comma-separated list of email addresses for the email BCC field, such as user1@example.com, user2@example.com.
A comma-separated list of paths for file attachments stored on the server, for example, /{FILE_DIRECTORY}/file.pdf, /{FILE_DIRECTORY}/image.jpg.

AIDescription: Forwards an existing email from a Microsoft Graph mailbox to specified recipients. This action allows users to include previous email threads and optionally send from a delegated mailbox. It supports adding attachments from either a Google Cloud Project (GCP) bucket or a local file system. ### Parameters | Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Send From | String | Yes | The email address to send from. Defaults to 'Default Mailbox' from the integration configuration. | | Mail ID | String | Yes | The unique ID or internetMessageId of the email to be forwarded. | | Folder Name | String | No | The mailbox folder where the original email is located (e.g., Inbox). | | Subject | String | Yes | The subject line for the forwarded email. | | Send to | String | Yes | A comma-separated list of recipient email addresses. | | CC | String | No | A comma-separated list of CC recipient email addresses. | | BCC | String | No | A comma-separated list of BCC recipient email addresses. | | Attachments Paths | String | No | A comma-separated list of file paths for attachments. | | Mail Content | String | Yes | The body content of the forwarded email. | | Attachment Location | String | Yes | Specifies if attachments are stored in a 'GCP Bucket' or 'Local File System'. | ### Flow 1. **Initialization**: Validates the sender's mailbox and ensures the source folder exists within that mailbox. 2. **Retrieval**: Fetches the details of the original email using the provided Mail ID to ensure it exists and is accessible. 3. **Attachment Processing**: If attachment paths are provided, the action validates their existence in the specified location (GCP or Local) and prepares them for upload. 4. **Draft Creation**: Calls the Microsoft Graph API to create a 'forward' draft of the original message, incorporating the new subject, recipients, and body content. 5. **Dispatch**: Sends the created draft email. 6. **Verification**: Polls the 'Sent Items' folder to confirm the email was successfully dispatched and retrieves the final sent object for the action results. ### Additional Notes This action does not process or interact with Google SecOps entities. It operates purely based on the provided parameters.
